tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page and section background (the PRD's "white" sections).

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Light-grey sections and card fills on `surface` (the PRD's "light grey").

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The black sections: hero, Section 3, Made in Nigeria, final CTA. Stays black in both themes; in dark mode separate it from `surface` with `line-inverse`.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and table rows sitting on `surface-inverse` (the Why Lumey cards).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-alt` and `sun-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, footnotes, small print and table metadata on `surface`, `surface-alt` and `sun-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse` and `surface-inverse-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-inverse` and `surface-inverse-raised`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table row dividers and card borders on light surfaces. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, and the unselected state of toggles, on `surface` (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: line-inverse
tokens.usage: Hairlines on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Lumey yellow. Fills: primary CTAs, the sizing band, the WhatsApp button, the H1 rule. As text or a mark only on `surface-inverse` (headings on black cards, stats). Never text on white.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Yellow tint behind price columns and the highlighted model in comparison tables.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `sun` fill. Always black, never white.

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Yellow-family text on light surfaces: eyebrows, the "Adds:" label on the ladder, links inside `sun-soft` cells.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Safety warnings only (the troubleshooting "stop and call us" panel, form errors). Text on `surface` and `alert-soft`.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the safety alert panel.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text on an `alert` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on `surface` and `surface-alt`: 2px solid with a 2px offset.

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on `surface-inverse` and on `sun` fills use `ink` instead.
